snippet.title: Knights of Legend for the Apple II
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

Commdore 64
DOS


Game description:

Create a party of adventurers from multiple races and explore the world, gaining fame and glory (not to mention gold) as you complete numerous quests. A well-designed inventory and turn-based combat system complement the role-playing aspects.


What I think:

It is actually an excellent RPG, but thanks to many disc swaps and an extremely long fight, it won't get the rating it actually would deserve.
